mapper.select: WITH creation_lock AS MATERIALIZED ( SELECT 1 AS acquired FROM pg_advisory_xact_lock( hashtextextended( 'membership_order_creation:' || CAST(#{loginIdentityId,jdbcType=BIGINT} AS TEXT), 0)) ), existing_by_idempotency AS MATERIALIZED ( SELECT membership_order.* FROM creation_lock JOIN membership_order ON membership_order.idempotency_key = #{idempotencyKey, javaType=java.util.UUID, jdbcType=OTHER, typeHandler=com.example.temperate.mapper.typehandler.PostgreSqlUuidTypeHandler} ), active_order AS MATERIALIZED ( SELECT membership_order.* FROM creation_lock JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT candidate.* FROM membership_order AS candidate WHERE candidate.login_identity_id = #{loginIdentityId,jdbcType=BIGINT} AND ( candidate.status IN (0, 1) OR (candidate.status = 2 AND candidate.entitlement_resolution IS NULL) ) ORDER BY candidate.created_at, candidate.id LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE ) AS membership_order ON TRUE WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM existing_by_idempotency) ), inserted AS ( INSERT INTO membership_order ( id, login_identity_id, membership_tier, pay_amount_yuan, pay_type, status, idempotency_key, provider_trade_no, payment_started_at, expires_at, closing_deadline_at, paid_at, entitlement_resolution, entitlement_resolved_at, state_version, created_at, updated_at ) SELECT #{id,jdbcType=BINARY}, #{loginIdentityId,jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{membershipTier,jdbcType=SMALLINT,typeHandler=com.example.temperate.mapper.typehandler.MembershipTierTypeHandler}, #{payAmountYuan,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{payType,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{status,jdbcType=SMALLINT,typeHandler=com.example.temperate.mapper.typehandler.MembershipOrderStatusTypeHandler}, #{idempotencyKey, javaType=java.util.UUID, jdbcType=OTHER, typeHandler=com.example.temperate.mapper.typehandler.PostgreSqlUuidTypeHandler}, #{providerTradeNo,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{paymentStartedAt,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP_WITH_TIMEZONE}, #{expiresAt,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP_WITH_TIMEZONE}, #{closingDeadlineAt,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP_WITH_TIMEZONE}, #{paidAt,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP_WITH_TIMEZONE}, #{entitlementResolution,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{entitlementResolvedAt,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP_WITH_TIMEZONE}, #{stateVersion,jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{createdAt,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP_WITH_TIMEZONE}, #{updatedAt,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP_WITH_TIMEZONE} FROM creation_lock JOIN userloginidentity ON userloginidentity.id = #{loginIdentityId,jdbcType=BIGINT} WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM existing_by_idempotency) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM active_order) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING RETURNING * ), resolved AS ( SELECT 1 AS source_priority, existing_by_idempotency.* FROM existing_by_idempotency UNION ALL SELECT 2 AS source_priority, active_order.* FROM active_order UNION ALL SELECT 3 AS source_priority, inserted.* FROM inserted ) SELECT id, login_identity_id, membership_tier, pay_amount_yuan, pay_type, status, idempotency_key, provider_trade_no, payment_started_at, expires_at, closing_deadline_at, paid_at, entitlement_resolution, entitlement_resolved_at, state_version, created_at, updated_at FROM resolved ORDER BY source_priority LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM membership_order WHERE idempotency_key = #{idempotencyKey, javaType=java.util.UUID, jdbcType=OTHER, typeHandler=com.example.temperate.mapper.typehandler.PostgreSqlUuidTypeHandler}
SELECT 1 FROM pg_advisory_xact_lock( hashtextextended( 'membership_order_creation:' || CAST(#{loginIdentityId,jdbcType=BIGINT} AS TEXT), 0))

mapper.update: UPDATE membership_order SET status = #{terminalStatus,jdbcType=SMALLINT,typeHandler=com.example.temperate.mapper.typehandler.MembershipOrderStatusTypeHandler}, closing_deadline_at = NULL, entitlement_resolution = COALESCE( membership_order.entitlement_resolution, 'NOT_GRANTED'), entitlement_resolved_at = CASE WHEN membership_order.entitlement_resolution IS NULL THEN #{changedAt,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP_WITH_TIMEZONE} ELSE membership_order.entitlement_resolved_at END, state_version = #{terminalStateVersion,jdbcType=BIGINT}, updated_at = GREATEST( membership_order.updated_at, #{changedAt,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP_WITH_TIMEZONE}) WHERE id = #{orderId,jdbcType=BINARY} AND login_identity_id = #{loginIdentityId,jdbcType=BIGINT} AND status IN (0, 1) AND state_version <= #{terminalStateVersion,jdbcType=BIGINT}

WITH requested AS ( SELECT DECODE(requested_value, 'hex') AS order_id, requested_ordinal FROM jsonb_array_elements_text( CAST(#{idsJson,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS JSONB) ) WITH ORDINALITY AS requested(requested_value, requested_ordinal) ) SELECT membership_order.id, membership_order.login_identity_id, membership_order.membership_tier, membership_order.pay_amount_yuan, membership_order.pay_type, membership_order.status, membership_order.idempotency_key, membership_order.provider_trade_no, membership_order.payment_started_at, membership_order.expires_at, membership_order.closing_deadline_at, membership_order.paid_at, membership_order.entitlement_resolution, membership_order.entitlement_resolved_at, membership_order.state_version, membership_order.created_at, membership_order.updated_at FROM requested JOIN membership_order ON membership_order.id = requested.order_id ORDER BY requested.requested_ordinal

WITH requested AS ( SELECT DECODE(requested_value, 'hex') AS order_id FROM jsonb_array_elements_text( CAST(#{idsJson,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS JSONB) ) AS requested(requested_value) ) SELECT FROM membership_order JOIN requested ON requested.order_id = membership_order.id ORDER BY membership_order.id FOR UPDATE OF membership_order
mapper.delete: WITH requested AS ( SELECT DECODE(requested_value, 'hex') AS order_id FROM jsonb_array_elements_text( CAST(#{idsJson,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS JSONB) ) AS requested(requested_value) ) DELETE FROM membership_order USING requested WHERE membership_order.id = requested.order_id
mapper.update: WITH raw_snapshots AS ( SELECT DECODE(raw."idHex", 'hex') AS order_id, raw.status, raw."providerTradeNo" AS provider_trade_no, raw."paymentStartedAt" AS payment_started_at, raw."closingDeadlineAt" AS closing_deadline_at, raw."paidAt" AS paid_at, raw."stateVersion" AS state_version, raw."updatedAt" AS updated_at FROM jsonb_to_recordset( CAST(#{snapshotsJson,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS JSONB) ) AS raw( "idHex" TEXT, status SMALLINT, "providerTradeNo" TEXT, "paymentStartedAt" TIMESTAMPTZ, "closingDeadlineAt" TIMESTAMPTZ, "paidAt" TIMESTAMPTZ, "stateVersion" BIGINT, "updatedAt" TIMESTAMPTZ ) ), snapshots AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (order_id) order_id, status, provider_trade_no, payment_started_at, closing_deadline_at, paid_at, state_version, updated_at FROM raw_snapshots ORDER BY order_id, state_version DESC ) UPDATE membership_order SET status = snapshots.status, provider_trade_no = COALESCE( membership_order.provider_trade_no, snapshots.provider_trade_no), payment_started_at = COALESCE( snapshots.payment_started_at, membership_order.payment_started_at), closing_deadline_at = snapshots.closing_deadline_at, paid_at = COALESCE(snapshots.paid_at, membership_order.paid_at), entitlement_resolution = CASE WHEN snapshots.status IN (3, 4) AND COALESCE(snapshots.paid_at, membership_order.paid_at) IS NULL AND membership_order.entitlement_resolution IS NULL THEN 'NOT_GRANTED' ELSE membership_order.entitlement_resolution END, entitlement_resolved_at = CASE WHEN snapshots.status IN (3, 4) AND COALESCE(snapshots.paid_at, membership_order.paid_at) IS NULL AND membership_order.entitlement_resolution IS NULL THEN snapshots.updated_at ELSE membership_order.entitlement_resolved_at END, state_version = snapshots.state_version, updated_at = snapshots.updated_at FROM snapshots WHERE membership_order.id = snapshots.order_id AND ( snapshots.provider_trade_no IS NULL OR membership_order.provider_trade_no IS NULL OR membership_order.provider_trade_no = snapshots.provider_trade_no ) AND ( membership_order.state_version < snapshots.state_version OR ( membership_order.state_version = snapshots.state_version AND membership_order.updated_at <= snapshots.updated_at AND CASE membership_order.status WHEN 0 THEN 0 WHEN 1 THEN 1 ELSE 2 END < CASE snapshots.status WHEN 0 THEN 0 WHEN 1 THEN 1 ELSE 2 END ) )

WITH raw_entitlements AS ( SELECT DECODE(raw."orderIdHex", 'hex') AS order_id, raw."providerTradeNo" AS provider_trade_no, raw.resolution, raw."resolvedAt" AS resolved_at FROM jsonb_to_recordset( CAST(#{entitlementsJson,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS JSONB) ) AS raw( "orderIdHex" TEXT, "providerTradeNo" VARCHAR(128), resolution TEXT, "resolvedAt" TIMESTAMPTZ ) ), entitlements AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (order_id) order_id, provider_trade_no, resolution, resolved_at FROM raw_entitlements ORDER BY order_id ) UPDATE membership_order SET provider_trade_no = CASE WHEN entitlements.resolution = 'REFUND_REQUIRED' THEN NULL ELSE COALESCE( membership_order.provider_trade_no, entitlements.provider_trade_no) END, entitlement_resolution = CASE WHEN membership_order.entitlement_resolution = 'NOT_GRANTED' AND entitlements.resolution = 'REFUND_REQUIRED' THEN entitlements.resolution ELSE COALESCE( membership_order.entitlement_resolution, entitlements.resolution) END, entitlement_resolved_at = CASE WHEN membership_order.entitlement_resolution = 'NOT_GRANTED' AND entitlements.resolution = 'REFUND_REQUIRED' THEN entitlements.resolved_at ELSE COALESCE( membership_order.entitlement_resolved_at, entitlements.resolved_at) END, updated_at = CASE WHEN membership_order.entitlement_resolution IS NULL OR ( membership_order.entitlement_resolution = 'NOT_GRANTED' AND entitlements.resolution = 'REFUND_REQUIRED' ) THEN GREATEST(membership_order.updated_at, entitlements.resolved_at) ELSE membership_order.updated_at END FROM entitlements WHERE membership_order.id = entitlements.order_id AND ( entitlements.provider_trade_no IS NULL OR membership_order.provider_trade_no IS NULL OR membership_order.provider_trade_no = entitlements.provider_trade_no ) AND ( membership_order.entitlement_resolution IS NULL OR membership_order.entitlement_resolution = entitlements.resolution OR ( membership_order.entitlement_resolution = 'NOT_GRANTED' AND entitlements.resolution = 'REFUND_REQUIRED' ) )
